entries.source: releases a burst of light, dealing %d light damage (based on Spellpower) in a radius 3 cone.
entries.target: 放出光系爆炸，在3格锥形范围内造成%d光系伤害（基于法术强度）。

entries.source: %s appears out of the thin air!
Afflicts the target with a curse: talents inflict %d fire damage and have increased cooldowns.
entries.target: 诅咒目标：释放技能时受到%d火焰伤害，冷却时间增加。

entries.source: @Target@ walks on a trap, and there is a loud noise.
entries.target: @Target@踩上陷阱，发出了巨大的声音。

entries.source: Releases a large boulder%s that smashes into the target for %d physical damage and knocks it back.
entries.target: 释放一块大石头%s，砸向目标，造成%d物理伤害并击退它。

entries.source: @Target@ activates a trap, and its magical energies change.
entries.target: @Target@激活了陷阱，魔法能量变化了。

entries.source: Projects a rapidly spinning beam of magical energies (range %d), dealing %d damage (%s%s#WHITE#) to those struck.
entries.target: 投射一束快速旋转的魔法能量（射程%d），对被击中的人造成%d点伤害（%s%s#WHITE#）。

entries.source: Releases a cloud of poison spores (radius %d), poisoning for #LIGHT_GREEN#%d#LAST# damage over 5 turns.
entries.target: 释放一团毒气孢子（半径%d），在5回合内造成#LIGHT_GREEN#%d#LAST#毒素伤害。

entries.source: The poison spore looks somewhat drained.
entries.target: 毒性孢子的能量似乎被抽取了。

entries.source: Releases up to 4 delayed fuse fireballs within range %d that each explode for #LIGHT_RED#%d#LAST# fire damage after %d turns.
entries.target: 在%d范围内释放最多4个延迟的引信火球，每个火球在%d回合后爆炸，造成#LIGHT_RED#%d#LAST#火焰伤害。

entries.source: Cold flames start to appear around @target@.
Cold flames slowly spread from %d spots within radius %d, The flames deal %d cold damage with a chance to freeze.
entries.target: 冷火焰在半径%d格范围内的%d点缓慢扩散，火焰造成%d点寒冷伤害并有机会冻结。
